{{Quote|It couldn't hold up to ''standard'' blaster-fire... but its ''refractory coating'' deflects these needle rays ''just fine''!|Han Solo|<ref name="SWM22" />}}
'''Refractory coating''' was applied to the personal [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]] used in the final round of [[the Big Game]] on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]]. The substance was not powerful enough to withstand normal [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts, but it could reflect the weaker blasts of the [[needle ray]]s used in the Big Game. A blast so reflected lost little of its potency, and was still deadly.<ref name="SWM22" /> By hiding a ray shield with refractory coating under his shirt, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was able to fake his own death from a needle ray blast.<ref name="SWM23">[[Star Wars (1977) 23|''Star Wars'' (1977) 23]]</ref>
